name: Diagnosing and Replacing Contactors
summary:
Diagnosing and Replacing Contactors is an immersive VR training application designed exclusively for learners enrolled in ImmerseLearn’s Diagnosing and Replacing Contactors micro-credential program.

This interactive simulation allows learners to develop practical skills in identifying faulty contactors, performing diagnostic procedures, understanding electrical system safety protocols, and executing proper replacement procedures in a realistic virtual environment.
